# The rule each invalid entry of vectors/entries.txt breaks, as the SDK
# names it (Rust: Invalid::<rule>; Go: Err<rule>, with TitleUtf8 as
# ErrTitleUTF8). The SDK's tests in both languages check that each is
# refused for this rule and each valid entry accepted.
bad-signature Signature
changed-title Signature
signed-by-another-key Signature
non-canonical-signature SignatureS
small-order-key Key
small-order-r SignatureR
non-canonical-r SignatureR
mixed-order-r Signature
small-order-key-signed Key
small-order-key-order-8-signed Key
non-canonical-key Key
kind-0 Kind
kind-255 Kind
seq-0 Seq
size-0 Size
size-over-1-mib Size
profile-size-4097 Size
profile-title-not-a-name Name
program-title-empty Name
title-not-utf8 TitleUtf8
title-121 TitleLength
length-mismatch Length
truncated Length
too-short Length
